    # ESTIMAND: viability_norm(A) - viability_norm(B), where

    # NOTE: 50 uL tip rack -> keep every single aspiration <= 40 uL.
    cell_vol = 40     # uL of cell suspension seeded per well
    treat_vol = 40    # uL of reagent added per well
    rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]
    wells_per_cell_reservoir = 20  # 20 wells x 40 uL = 800 uL (< 1 mL well)

    # Trough assignments (12-channel reservoir):
    #   A1 = Formulation A | A2 = Formulation B
    #   A3 = Vehicle control medium | A4 = Blank medium (no treatment)
    reagent_map = {
        "formulation_a": trough["A1"],
        "formulation_b": trough["A2"],
        "vehicle": trough["A3"],
        "blank_medium": trough["A4"],
    }
    # Dedicated tip per reagent group to avoid cross-contamination
    treatment_tips = {
        "formulation_a": "A2",
        "formulation_b": "A3",
        "vehicle": "A4",
        "blank_medium": "A5",
    }

    # Destination-plate layout (treatment groups)
    groups = {
        "formulation_a": [f"{r}{c}" for c in (1, 2) for r in rows],
        "formulation_b": [f"{r}{c}" for c in (3, 4) for r in rows],
        "vehicle": [f"{r}5" for r in rows],
        "blank_medium": [f"{r}12" for r in rows],  # background control
    }
    # Wells that receive cells (all groups except medium-only blanks)
    cell_wells = (
        groups["formulation_a"] + groups["formulation_b"] + groups["vehicle"]
    )

    # Sanity check on tip capacity before touching any liquid
    max_vol = max(cell_vol, treat_vol)
    if max_vol > 50:
        raise ValueError(f"Volume {max_vol} uL exceeds 50 uL tip capacity.")

    # -------------------- 3. Seed cells into assay wells ---------------
    print(f"[DESIGN] Seeding {len(cell_wells)} wells with {cell_vol} uL cells")

    current_res = None
    for idx, well_name in enumerate(cell_wells):
        if idx % wells_per_cell_reservoir == 0:
            # Switch to next cell-suspension reservoir and re-homogenize
            # the suspension so every well receives a uniform cell dose
            current_res = cell_reservoirs[idx // wells_per_cell_reservoir]
            await lh.mix(current_res, vols=[cell_vol], repeats=5)
        await lh.aspirate(current_res, vols=[cell_vol])
        await lh.dispense(dest[well_name], vols=[cell_vol])
    await lh.drop_tips()

    print("[DESIGN] Applying treatments: A (cols 1-2), B (cols 3-4), "

    for reagent_name in ("formulation_a", "formulation_b",
